Title: Verify current user cannot delete their own employee record
Test Data: Employee ID = Current User Employee ID
Steps: 1. Attempt to delete own employee record.
Expected Result: Request is rejected. Record is not deleted.

Title: Verify employee ID must be unique
Steps: 1. Attempt to create a new employee with an existing employee ID.
Expected Result: Request is rejected with message 'Employee Id already exists'.

Title: Verify employee can be created with valid minimum data
Steps: 1. Send POST request with valid minimum data.

Title: Verify First Name length validation
Steps: 1. Attempt to create employee with First Name > 30 chars.
Expected Result: Request is rejected with length validation error.

Title: Verify Work Email and Other Email cannot be the same
Steps: 1. Attempt to update contact details setting Work Email and Other Email to the same value.
Expected Result: Request is rejected with "Work Email and Other Email Cannot Be The Same".

Title: Verify Work Email must be unique across employees
Steps: 1. Attempt to set Work Email to an email already used by another employee.
Expected Result: Request is rejected with unique email validation error.

Title: Verify profile picture size validation
Steps: 1. Attempt to upload a profile picture larger than 1MB.
Expected Result: Request is rejected with size validation error.

Title: Verify assigning invalid Subunit is rejected
Steps: 1. Attempt to assign an employee to a non-existent Subunit.
Expected Result: Request is rejected. Foreign key validation fails.

Title: Verify EmployeeAddedEvent is dispatched and handled when new employee is created
Preconditions: Leave/Time modules are active and listening
Steps: 1. Create a new employee in PIM. 2. Verify that the Leave module has allocated default leave entitlements or created the employee profile.
Expected Result: Employee is created. Leave entitlements are correctly populated when queried via GET /api/v2/leave/entitlements.

Title: Verify JoinedDateChangedEvent triggers when joined date is updated
Steps: 1. Update the Joined Date of an existing employee in Job Details.
Expected Result: The `JoinedDateChangedEvent` is dispatched and successfully processed by listening modules.

Title: Verify EmployeeDeletedEvent is dispatched when employee is deleted
Preconditions: Employee exists and is not admin
Steps: 1. Delete the employee. 2. Verify that associated System User is disabled/deleted (if applicable).
Expected Result: Employee is deleted and event triggers downstream cleanup (System user disabled).

Title: Hire and onboard a new employee
Test Data: Employee details, Contact details, Job details
Steps: 1. Navigate to PIM -> Add Employee. 2. Enter personal details and save. 3. Navigate to Contact Details and enter address. 4. Navigate to Job Details and assign Job Title/Subunit.
Expected Result: Employee is created and all profile tabs are correctly populated and saved.

Title: Terminate an employee and verify status
Expected Result: 1. Search for an employee. 2. Navigate to Job Details. 3. Click Terminate Employment. 4. Fill in details and confirm.
Gap / Assumption: Employee status is changed to Terminated and the termination details are recorded.
